verdict.rationale: Fireworks AI is an inference and fine-tuning platform, so background automations are a fair axis, but the evidence shows no product-owned feature for setting up autonomous, recurring automations. Batch inference is a one-off asynchronous job, not a recurring schedule. Tool calling and the REST API are developer building blocks for constructing agents or automation. Autoscaling and Auto Reload are adjacent platform behaviors, not user-defined automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
